prompt: Our audio post-production studio has a 'studio/' folder that's been growing messily for years. I need a quick audit of all WAV files that the team has been actively editing — specifically those that are a reasonable mid-size (between 150 KB and 800 KB) and were last touched somewhere between 2 and 7 days ago. Some of these files may be sitting in our staging directories, which are excluded from version control, so please make sure those get picked up too. We also need to stay focused on assets within the first 4 levels of the folder hierarchy under 'studio/', to avoid pulling in deep archive sessions. The final deliverable should be a file called `audit_report.txt` saved somewhere in the workspace, containing just the filenames (no folder paths) — one per line — so the team can quickly scan the list.
